verdict.rationale: Meltano documents a CLI (including `meltano run`) and built-in monitoring and alerts. However, there is no evidence of an API or MCP server that would let an agent check sync status, diagnose a failed run, and re-trigger it. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404. A CLI that an agent might shell out to is an adjacent workaround, not the API/MCP capability the story names.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can check sync status, diagnose a failed run, and re-trigger it through an API or MCP server
